title: Advance one remaining OpenAI-math model bridge
research_target: Select and advance ONE exact mathematical interface remaining outside the five landed OpenAI-math milestones. Start from the pinned portfolio: Wilson normalization and neutral-mode control (215); phase/gauge and boundary twist (261); matching/gadget controls (113/120); dimer entropy/coefficient selection (265); Spin(10) phase interface (204); finite-centralizer hypothesis mismatch (290); or stationary moving-record interfaces (145/154). Read the actual model and theorem statements and current main before choosing. Prioritize a bridge with a concrete new proof obligation and feasible decisive control. Preserve the existing hypothesis mismatches as local comparisons, not general impossibility theorems. The corrected family145 noninvertible-endomorphism observation and the five already-landed results are background, not new hits. Prove a scoped new bridge, give an exact counterexample to a proposed bridge, or record a substantive partial derivation and its first unresolved step. Do not reopen or copy the closed PR packages, demand duplicate verification of a matching accepted Lean theorem, or silently extend a paper-only result to a formalized companion.
completion_criterion: A new scoped proof, exact counterexample or checked partial derivation with the first unresolved step; retrieval, review summaries and already-known mismatches are not completion.
